title: CommonTrace Working Memory Block
description: A stateful, bounded, auditable working memory block (Letta Core Memory pattern) used by autonomous agents for persistent prompt scratchpads.

name.description: Unique identifier for the memory block (e.g. persona, human, project).

content.description: Markdown text content stored within the memory block.

max_chars.description: Character budget quota ceiling allocated to this block.

revision.description: 16-character SHA-256 revision hash computed over f'{name}:{content}:{prev_revision}'.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the block was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the block was last updated.
